verdict.rationale: The axis applies because Nitrokey ships an API product: NetHSM exposes a REST API with an OpenAPI spec. However, nothing in the pack documents issuing scoped, role-limited or least-privilege API credentials for that API or for any agent. The USB keys' authentication features (FIDO2, OTP, PIV, OpenPGP) are user-login capabilities, not scoped API credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
